name: Orondia
description: Orondia was a desolate world in the Orondia system in Hutt Space. During the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi, disguised as Rako Hardeen, Cad Bane, and Moralo Eval were scammed into stopping there when a Bith gave him only enough fuel to reach Orondia, where his brother ran a fueling station.
